sample_unit: chatbot responses to rhinology treatment questions

links.outcome: Flesch Reading Ease readability of chatbot responses on rhinology treatments
links.effect: FRE scores were 33.17 (ChatGPT), 35.93 (Plus), 46.50 (Bard), 46.32 (Bing); Bard and Bing were more readable than ChatGPT and Plus, but all scores are in the difficult range.
links.quote: ChatGPT, Plus, Bard, and Bing had FRE readability scores of 33.17, 35.93, 46.50, and 46.32, respectively, indicating higher readability for Bard and Bing compared to ChatGPT (p = 0.003, p = 0.008) and Plus (p = 0.025, p = 0.048).

screen.reason: Evaluates commercial LLM chatbots on standardized questions regarding rhinology treatments for readability, quality, and accuracy without testing a specific organizational deployment practice or guardrail.
